thread:
Dana: Heads-up  found a billing gap after we migrated cohort pricing midday. Several reserved customers in the prepaid cohort were moved to price_v4 without their grandfathered prepaid credit, e.g., INV-9882 shows $3,200 vs expected $2,400.
Omar: Oof. Which subset of customers? Prepaid cohort IDs?
Dana: Affected tag = prepaid-q1, about 4 invoices so far. Delta matches the prepaid credit amount exactly, so mapping didn't attach the credit token during price swap.
Sven: Did the migration job drop the "apply_prepaid_credit" column? We had a schema change note but I thought it was backwards compatible.
Lucia: We changed the manifest schema to split credit policy into a separate table. Migration step was to join on customer_id; looks like the join failed for customers with legacy_account_id present.
Omar: So a join-key mismatch. Policy: credits > $500 require controller review. Any invoice > $500? Yep INV-9882 delta = $800. Tagging controller.
ControllerBot: Controller alert: FIN-2799 created. Controller sign-off required for credits > $500. Please include audit lines and migration plan.
Dana: Proposed immediate actions:
1) Run dry-run reconcile on affected invoices to compute exact deltas.
2) Queue one-time credits for acknowledged deltas once Controller signs.
3) Re-run migration join fixing legacy_account_id handling and re-upload price manifest.
4) Add manifest preflight check to fail if any customers in prepaid cohort lack a matching credit token.
Sven: Commands I will run (dry-run first):
```
# list affected invoices
billing-cli invoices search --query "tag:prepaid-q1 AND created>2026-05-20" --output json
# dry-run reconcile example
billing-cli invoices reconcile --invoice INV-9882 --dry-run
# dry-run credits
billing-cli credits create --invoice INV-9882 --amount 800 --reason "prepaid credit backfill" --dry-run
```
Lucia: I'll prepare the migration fix and a backfill script. Can we hold apply for 1 hour so Sales and Support can prepare customer comms?
Omar: Hold acknowledged. Controller, any objections to the backfill after we confirm the dry-run?
ControllerBot: No objection in principle. Approve after audit doc attached and CS review. Ensure FIN-2799 has all reconciliation outputs.
Dana: I'll draft customer message: brief apology, explain technical migration miss, confirm one-time credit applied and invoice note added. Will post draft here for review.
Sven: I'll also add a post-deploy monitor to scan prepaid-q1 invoices for next 5 billing runs and alert #finance on any delta > $100.
AccountingBot: INV-9882 generated 2026-05-20 06:04 UTC. Status: paid. Note: dry-run operations do not modify ledger. Credits when applied will create negative line items and update GL.
Lucia: After controller sign-off and CS ok, I'll run the backfill and re-run reconciles. Will attach migration diff and scripts to FIN-2799.
Omar: Thanks. Small doc update: rollout checklist item "verify credit_token join for legacy_account_id". Also schedule a quick retro to avoid schema split hazards.
Dana: Great. I'll post the customer-facing note here shortly. :white_check_mark:
